function.name: garcia_research
function.description: Research a security or technology topic using the Garcia Research Pipeline. Returns an evidence-based report with source URLs and insights. The optional Python package runs locally and does not publish artifacts; production persistence is handled by the Cloudflare Worker. Use for questions requiring current external technical research; do not use for ordinary explanations.

topic.description: Technical or security topic to investigate.

depth.description: Research breadth: quick (2 queries), standard (5), deep (up to 8).

focus.description: Optional keywords or aspects to emphasize.
